fixtures.name: delivered
fixtures.note: An ordinary delivered event, exactly as the worker serialises it.

fixtures.name: bounced_unicode
fixtures.note: Non-ASCII in the payload. The HMAC is over UTF-8 bytes, so a receiver that hashes a differently-encoded string fails here and nowhere else.

fixtures.name: script_tag
fixtures.note: An embedded </script> and a lone backslash. Nothing here may be escaped, unescaped or normalised on the way into the HMAC.

fixtures.name: reserialisation_trap
fixtures.note: Two spaces, a trailing newline and keys in an order json.dumps would not reproduce. Verifying a parsed-then-re-serialised body fails on exactly this, which is the most common support question about webhooks.

fixtures.name: empty_body
fixtures.note: A zero-length body still signs. The signed payload is the timestamp, a dot, and nothing.

fixtures.name: wrong_secret
